blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Length / Story

blocks.source: 難易度ノーマルでクリアまで１２０時間。
blocks.translation: It took 120 hours to complete on Normal difficulty.

blocks.source: サブイベントはほぼ見ているが、一部のセリフは飛ばし気味に読んでもこの時間。
blocks.translation: I completed almost all of the side events, though I did tend to skim some of the dialogue, and it still took that long.

blocks.source: 閃の軌跡１～２のレビューを見直したら、クリアまで６０～７０時間と書いてあった。プレイスタイルはほぼ同じなので、これがそのまま作品規模の差のはず。
blocks.translation: Looking back at my reviews of Trails of Cold Steel I and II, I wrote that they took 60–70 hours to complete. Since my playstyle was nearly the same, this should represent the difference in the scale of the games themselves.

blocks.source: とにかく大変長かった。恐らくは軌跡シリーズで最長の作品になると思う。
blocks.translation: In any case, it was extremely long. I suspect it will be the longest game in the Trails series.

blocks.source: ストーリー
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 前作の衝撃のラストから一転、序盤は主人公リィン不在のままゆったりとした展開が続く。この辺は閃の軌跡１に対する２の流れに近い。
blocks.translation: Following the shocking ending of the previous game, the story progresses at a relaxed pace in the early stages, with protagonist Rean absent. In this respect, it resembles the way Trails of Cold Steel II followed the first game.

blocks.source: 空の軌跡１から閃の軌跡３まで八作にも及ぶ過去作品から数多くのキャラクターが登場。
blocks.translation: Numerous characters from eight previous games, from Trails in the Sky FC through Trails of Cold Steel III, make an appearance.

blocks.source: 個人的に嬉しかったのは、空の軌跡以来となるギルバートの再登場。元市長秘書がこんな息の長いキャラになるなんて……。
blocks.translation: What personally made me happy was Gilbert's return, his first appearance since Trails in the Sky. Who would have thought that a former mayor's secretary would become such a long-running character...?

blocks.source: 反面、キャラを回すばかりでストーリーに進展がない部分も。閃３は主人公の立ち位置を変えることで一定の新鮮さがあったけど、今回はそれもない。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, there are parts where the story makes no progress as it simply cycles through the characters. Trails of Cold Steel III had a certain freshness from changing the protagonist's position, but this time even that is absent.

blocks.source: 序盤から既存キャラの顔見せ的なイベントがダラダラと続く。
blocks.translation: Events that amount to little more than introducing existing characters drag on from the very beginning.

blocks.source: なんせとにかくキャラが多い上に、サブキャラまでまんべんなく拾ってくるのがこの作品。敵も味方も見た顔ばっかり。
blocks.translation: After all, this game has an enormous cast, and it even makes sure to cover all the supporting characters. Both the enemies and allies are almost entirely familiar faces.

blocks.source: 基本的に敵キャラと戦っても決着はつかないし、一部を除いて死人も出ない。
blocks.translation: As a rule, even when you fight an enemy, the battle does not reach a conclusion, and aside from a few exceptions, nobody dies.

blocks.source: 全体的に「お前達を試す」みたいなノリのボス戦が多め。「全力でやる」「本気でやる」と戦うたびに強調されるけれど、やはり戦いごっこ感が否めない。
blocks.translation: Overall, there are many boss battles with the attitude of “We're going to test you.” They repeatedly emphasize that they will fight “with everything they've got” and “seriously,” but it still feels unavoidably like playing at combat.

blocks.source: ともあれ、閃２～３と違って今回は終盤で決着をつけるだけマシだろうか。
blocks.translation: In any case, unlike Trails of Cold Steel II and III, I suppose it's at least better that things are settled toward the end this time.

blocks.source: 色々と不満はあったのだけど、なんといっても帝国編（リィン編）の完結作。いくつかの山場は、非常に気合が入ったものになっている。
blocks.translation: I had various complaints, but above all, this is the conclusion of the Imperial Arc (Rean Arc). Several of the climactic moments were clearly made with tremendous effort.

blocks.source: ラストも大風呂敷をかなり頑張って畳んでおり、個人的にも満足のいく出来だった。
blocks.translation: The ending also does a remarkable job of tying together its many huge plot threads, and I was personally satisfied with how it turned out.

blocks.source: 特に今回は軌跡シリーズの根幹となる謎にも終盤で一部触れられる。もっとも、この辺は軌跡シリーズの完結まで引っ張りそうだけど。
blocks.translation: In particular, this time the game finally touches on some of the mysteries at the heart of the Trails series toward the end. That said, it seems likely that these matters will be dragged out until the series is complete.

blocks.source: 絆イベント
blocks.translation: Bonding Events

blocks.source: 今作も絆イベントによって、仲間達と仲を深めることができる。
blocks.translation: As in the previous game, bonding events allow you to deepen your relationships with your companions.

blocks.source: 今回の絆イベントは恋愛色が強い。恐ろしいことに、驚異のリィンハーレムに拍車がかかっている。ルートに入らなくても、大勢の女性から告白される始末。ここまで行くとちょっと怖い。
blocks.translation: The bonding events this time have a strong romantic focus. Astonishingly, Rean's already incredible harem has only grown more prominent. Even without pursuing their routes, he ends up being confessed to by a large number of women. At this point, it is a little frightening.

blocks.source: 女性キャラとの恋愛色が強いけれど、個人的には旧VII男性メンバーとのイベントがわりと好きだったりする。
blocks.translation: Although the romance with the female characters is emphasized, I actually rather enjoyed the events with the male members of the old Class VII.

blocks.source: テキスト
blocks.translation: Writing

blocks.source: 相変わらず気になるのはテキストの質。ライターのクセが丸出しで、似たような表現のオンパレードである。
blocks.translation: The quality of the writing remains a concern. The writer's quirks are on full display, resulting in a parade of similar expressions.

blocks.source: ◆例
blocks.translation: ◆Examples
Ah...

blocks.source: はは、ふふ。
blocks.translation: Haha, hehe.

blocks.source: ～というか、ていうか、といいますか。（文末）
blocks.translation: Or rather, I mean, how should I put it... (at the end of a sentence)

blocks.source: 特にキャラを問わず「というか」の文末への多様は気持ち悪いレベルというか。
blocks.translation: Regardless of the character, the overuse of “or rather” at the ends of sentences reaches an almost unsettling level.

blocks.source: 普通に「～だな」とかでよい文末を「～というか」で締めるから、凄く違和感があるというか。閃３の時にはなかったはずなのに、なんで新たなクセが増えているのというか。
blocks.translation: They end sentences that could simply use something like “I guess” with “or rather,” which feels extremely unnatural. It wasn't present in Trails of Cold Steel III, so why has a new quirk been added, or rather?

blocks.source: 根本的な問題として「伏線をたくさん張り巡らした先が気になる作風」と「寄り道要素が充実した作風」という二種類の作風の組み合わせが噛み合っていないように思う。
blocks.translation: At a fundamental level, I feel that the combination of two types of storytelling does not work: one that makes you curious about where its many foreshadowed plot threads will lead, and one rich in detours and side content.

blocks.source: 後者を充実させれば当然展開は遅くなるし、前者を期待するプレイヤーはイライラしてしまう。しかも、それで分作になっているのだからなおさら。
blocks.translation: Naturally, fleshing out the latter slows the progression, frustrating players who are invested in the former. Even more so when the result is a series split across multiple games.

blocks.source: 「もっとテンポよく進めたら１～２作でまとまっただろ」
blocks.translation: "If you'd moved the story along at a better pace, you could have wrapped it up in one or two games."

blocks.source: なんて批判を受けてしまうのも必然というもの。
blocks.translation: It is only natural that the game would receive criticism like that.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / User-Friendliness

blocks.source: システム面は基本的に閃の軌跡３と同じ。そして、３に引き続き、ぶん投げ気味のゲームバランス。
blocks.translation: The systems are basically the same as in Trails of Cold Steel III. And, just like in III, the game balance feels rather thrown together.

blocks.source: 色々とカスタマイズ性は高いのだけど、行き着く先は単調なゴリ押し。
blocks.translation: There is a great deal of customization, but it ultimately leads to monotonous brute force.

blocks.source: オーダーやブレイクが若干弱体しているなど、多少の調整は入っている。……が、所詮は申し訳程度に３よりマシかなという程度。
blocks.translation: There have been some minor adjustments, such as Orders and Break being slightly weakened. ...But at best, it is only marginally better than III.

blocks.source: 難易度ノーマルだと序盤は少し厳しい部分もあるけれど、装備が整う中盤以降はほとんどの戦闘がノーダメージで終わる。
blocks.translation: Normal difficulty can be somewhat challenging in the early stages, but from the middle of the game onward, once your equipment is in order, most battles end without you taking any damage.

blocks.source: ボス戦でも最初の数回だけ攻撃を喰らえば、後は完封なんてこともザラ。というか、普通にやっててラスボスはほぼノーダメージでした。
blocks.translation: Even in boss battles, it was often enough to take a few hits at the beginning, after which you could completely shut the boss down. In fact, playing normally, I took almost no damage from the final boss.

blocks.source: 黙々と一方的に敵を倒すのは、やっていて虚しいものがあった。ＲＰＧとしての面白さに疑問を感じる。
blocks.translation: Defeating enemies unilaterally, over and over, felt empty. It made me question the fun of it as an RPG.

blocks.source: とにかく足すばかりで、引き算のないゲームデザインがどうなるかという一つの例。
blocks.translation: One example of what game design becomes when you keep adding things without ever subtracting anything.

blocks.source: バランスが壊れてるんじゃなくて、ルールが壊れているというべきか。たぶん制作者もよく分かっていない。というか、半ば諦めてるんじゃないかな。
blocks.translation: Rather than saying the balance is broken, perhaps it would be more accurate to say the rules are broken. The creators probably do not understand them very well either. In fact, maybe they have half given up.

blocks.source: 不満点はたくさんあるけど、閃３で散々突っ込んだので割愛。基本的に３からの進歩はないと思って問題ないです。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of things I disliked, but I went into them at length in Trails of Cold Steel III, so I will omit them here. It is safe to assume that there has basically been no progress since III.

blocks.source: ミニゲーム
blocks.translation: Minigames

blocks.source: ３から引き続き登場のカードゲームＶＭはけっこうよくできていると思う。難しくはないけど、大味な戦闘よりはよほど頭を使うし面白い。
blocks.translation: The card game V.M., which returns from III, is quite well made, I think. It is not difficult, but it requires far more thought and is much more fun than the simplistic battles.

blocks.source: 碧の軌跡以来（たぶん）となる落ちゲーの『ポムっと』もあるけど、こっちはやたら難しい。完全攻略しようと思うと、結構時間を食わされる。
blocks.translation: There is also Pomott, a falling-block game that has apparently not appeared since Trails of Azure. This one, however, is ridiculously difficult. Trying to complete it will eat up quite a lot of time.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: グラフィックの質は３と変わらない。相変わらずＰＳ４にしてはイベントシーンの演出は物足りないレベル。
blocks.translation: The graphics quality is unchanged from III. As always, the event scenes are underwhelming for a PS4 game.

blocks.source: とはいえ、個人的にはこれだけあれば十分だと思っている。ＦＦシリーズみたく、グラフィックに力を入れすぎて開発に時間をかけるよりも全然いい。
blocks.translation: That said, I personally think this is more than sufficient. It is much better than spending too much time on development by putting excessive effort into the graphics, like the Final Fantasy series.

blocks.source: なんといっても、空～碧の軌跡のキャラが現代のモデリングで見られるのは感動。今回はかなりたくさんのキャラが各作品から再登場する。
blocks.translation: Above all, it is moving to see the characters from Trails in the Sky through Trails of Azure in modern models. This time, quite a large number of characters reappear from the various games.

blocks.source: オープニングアニメは１～３で一番微妙かも。ただエンディングの豊富な一枚絵はかなりよかった。
blocks.translation: The opening animation may be the weakest of I–III. However, the many individual illustrations in the ending were quite good.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 音楽に定評のあるファルコム。
blocks.translation: Falcom is renowned for its music.

blocks.source: 山場のイベントは音楽でしっかり盛り上げるし、ラストダンジョンなどダンジョン曲の充実も光る。
blocks.translation: The music does a great job of heightening the pivotal events, and the wealth of dungeon tracks, including those for the final dungeon, is another highlight.

blocks.source: 反面、戦闘はちょっと印象が薄いかも。特に通常戦闘曲はよく思い出せない。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, the battle music may be somewhat forgettable. I especially cannot remember the regular battle theme.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 全体的に質より量に作品が偏ってしまっている印象。
blocks.translation: Overall, I got the impression that the game leans toward quantity over quality.

blocks.source: 『足りない』というよりは、余計なものが多い。一作品としてもシリーズとしても長過ぎる。それによって、結果的に不満点が目立っている部分は間違いなくあるはず。
blocks.translation: Rather than being lacking, it has too many unnecessary elements. It is far too long, both as a single game and as a series. As a result, there are undoubtedly aspects where the flaws stand out more.

blocks.source: まともに調整すれば、ペルソナシリーズなどの名作級に面白くなると思っているのだけど……。実際、閃１の段階ではかなり期待していた。
blocks.translation: I think it could become as enjoyable as a classic in the Persona series if it were properly refined, though... In fact, I had high hopes for it at the stage of Trails of Cold Steel I.

blocks.source: 冗長なイベントは削る。
blocks.translation: Cut redundant events.

blocks.source: それこそサブクエストは全廃でもいいぐらい。
blocks.translation: I would even say that side quests could be eliminated entirely.

blocks.source: システムも単純にしてゲームバランスを取る。
blocks.translation: Simplify the systems as well to achieve better game balance.

blocks.source: ミニゲームや料理などのやりこみ要素もバッサリ切る。
blocks.translation: Cut minigames, cooking, and other completionist content outright.

blocks.source: プレイ時間は半分ぐらいまで削って品質を高める。
blocks.translation: Reduce the playtime by about half and improve the quality.

blocks.source: そもそも分作しない。
blocks.translation: Do not split it into multiple games in the first place.

blocks.source: 自分が制作者ならこんな感じにするかなあ……と、妄想してみます。
blocks.translation: I will indulge in some speculation, imagining that I would do something like this if I were the creator...

texts.黙々と一方的に敵を倒すのは、やっていて虚しいものがあった。ＲＰＧとしての面白さに: Defeating enemies unilaterally, over and over, felt empty. It made me question the fun of it as an RPG.
texts.とにかく足すばかりで、引き算のないゲームデザインがどうなるかという一つの例。: One example of what game design becomes when you keep adding things without ever subtracting anything.
texts.バランスが壊れてるんじゃなくて、ルールが壊れているというべきか。たぶん制作者もよ: Rather than saying the balance is broken, perhaps it would be more accurate to say the rules are broken. The creators probably do not understand them very well either. In fact, maybe they have half given up.
texts.不満点はたくさんあるけど、閃３で散々突っ込んだので割愛。基本的に３からの進歩はな: There are plenty of things I disliked, but I went into them at length in Trails of Cold Steel III, so I will omit them here. It is safe to assume that there has basically been no progress since III.
texts.３から引き続き登場のカードゲームＶＭはけっこうよくできていると思う。難しくはない: The card game V.M., which returns from III, is quite well made, I think. It is not difficult, but it requires far more thought and is much more fun than the simplistic battles.
texts.碧の軌跡以来（たぶん）となる落ちゲーの『ポムっと』もあるけど、こっちはやたら難し: There is also Pomott, a falling-block game that has apparently not appeared since Trails of Azure. This one, however, is ridiculously difficult. Trying to complete it will eat up quite a lot of time.
texts.グラフィックの質は３と変わらない。相変わらずＰＳ４にしてはイベントシーンの演出は: The graphics quality is unchanged from III. As always, the event scenes are underwhelming for a PS4 game.
texts.とはいえ、個人的にはこれだけあれば十分だと思っている。ＦＦシリーズみたく、グラフ: That said, I personally think this is more than sufficient. It is much better than spending too much time on development by putting excessive effort into the graphics, like the Final Fantasy series.
texts.なんといっても、空～碧の軌跡のキャラが現代のモデリングで見られるのは感動。今回は: Above all, it is moving to see the characters from Trails in the Sky through Trails of Azure in modern models. This time, quite a large number of characters reappear from the various games.
texts.オープニングアニメは１～３で一番微妙かも。ただエンディングの豊富な一枚絵はかなり: The opening animation may be the weakest of I–III. However, the many individual illustrations in the ending were quite good.
texts.音楽に定評のあるファルコム。: Falcom is renowned for its music.
texts.山場のイベントは音楽でしっかり盛り上げるし、ラストダンジョンなどダンジョン曲の充: The music does a great job of heightening the pivotal events, and the wealth of dungeon tracks, including those for the final dungeon, is another highlight.
texts.反面、戦闘はちょっと印象が薄いかも。特に通常戦闘曲はよく思い出せない。: On the other hand, the battle music may be somewhat forgettable. I especially cannot remember the regular battle theme.
texts.全体的に質より量に作品が偏ってしまっている印象。: Overall, I got the impression that the game leans toward quantity over quality.
texts.『足りない』というよりは、余計なものが多い。一作品としてもシリーズとしても長過ぎ: Rather than being lacking, it has too many unnecessary elements. It is far too long, both as a single game and as a series. As a result, there are undoubtedly aspects where the flaws stand out more.
texts.まともに調整すれば、ペルソナシリーズなどの名作級に面白くなると思っているのだけど: I think it could become as enjoyable as a classic in the Persona series if it were properly refined, though... In fact, I had high hopes for it at the stage of Trails of Cold Steel I.
texts.それこそサブクエストは全廃でもいいぐらい。: I would even say that side quests could be eliminated entirely.
texts.システムも単純にしてゲームバランスを取る。: Simplify the systems as well to achieve better game balance.
texts.ミニゲームや料理などのやりこみ要素もバッサリ切る。: Cut minigames, cooking, and other completionist content outright.
texts.プレイ時間は半分ぐらいまで削って品質を高める。: Reduce the playtime by about half and improve the quality.
texts.そもそも分作しない。: Do not split it into multiple games in the first place.
texts.自分が制作者ならこんな感じにするかなあ……と、妄想してみます。: I will indulge in some speculation, imagining that I would do something like this if I were the creator...
